definitions.explanation: Money paid regularly to an employee for their work.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}は{毎月|まいつき}25{日|にち}に{出|で}ます。
examples.english: Salary is paid on the 25th of every month.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}が{上|あ}がりました。
{給料|きゅうりょう}だけでは{生活|せいかつ}が{大変|たいへん}です。
examples.english: It's hard to live on just my salary.

notes: 給料 is the general term for salary or wages. 月給 (げっきゅう) means monthly salary, and 年収 (ねんしゅう) means annual income. 給料日 (きゅうりょうび) is payday. In Japan, many companies pay on the 25th of each month.
